description.label: Description
description.value:
Trivial Physical Mutation

You sprout 1d6 additional eyes, ears, mouths or noses. Consult the table below to find out which kind and the @Table[hitloc]{Hit Locations} Table to find out where. The new sensory organs are fully functional, but apart from an eye in the back (which could grant the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.0LdHytqyNmg2pcAX]{Combat Aware} Talent if the GM is feeling generous) they aren't very likely to provide any special modifiers or abilities. If you're unlucky the new organ grows over an existing one, like a mouth over an eye.
